description: MainActivity.java for an Android Wear app that manages watch face backgrounds and gesture interactions.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: The main activity managing UI layout and gesture interactions in a Wear OS application.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets content view, and sets up layout inflated listener and gesture detector.

methods.name: onLayoutClicked
methods.description: Handles click events on the layout, triggering scale or rotation animations depending on layout type.

methods.name: dispatchTouchEvent
methods.description: Overrides default touch event dispatch to include gesture detection logic.
